kjv: unto us which are saved it is the power of God
mine: to us who are being saved it is the power of God
note: Present participles "apollymenois / sozomenois" describe processes ("perishing / being saved"); the KJV keeps "perish" progressive but makes "saved" a completed state.

kjv: by the foolishness of preaching to save them that believe
mine: through the folly of what we preach to save those who believe
note: kerygma is the content preached (the message of the cross), not the act of preaching; the KJV phrase is often quoted as a defence of preaching as such.
